title: Tactical RPG Fans?
author: marceleas
selftext:
​

Is anyone else into tactical RPG's? I've been a huge fan of Final Fantasy Tactics and the Tactics Ogre series, and always dreamt of designing a similar game.

Over the last 3 weeks I’ve been working on a turn-based tactical RPG in Godot, and I just put up a small preview site to start sharing early progress and get feedback. It’s still in **very early** development, but the core battle systems are already up and running in-engine.

I handle the game design, class/ability concepts, rules, visual direction, playtesting, and decisions on what works or gets scrapped. Using AI agents as a hands-on development partner to help implement GDScript systems, combat rules, UI, VFX/shaders, test harnesses, early art iteration, and even the preview website.

Claude: I've hooked in both PixelLab and Elevenlabs. PixelLab is responsible for nearly all character sprites and animations entirely  orchestrated by Claude. I'll be handed sprites and animations by the art agent to provide feedback or approve what looks good. It does similarly with ElevenLabs: I'll ask it for specific sound effects, review what it gives me and play around with them in-game to see if it works.

AntiGravity: Since Google has some decent image generation, I've mainly used it to build character art and portraits. I've also used it to review code and test for bugs. I see myself using it more in the future with Neon being such a strong model.

It also fully build the website.

It still takes a lot of testing, debugging, and iteration to get abilities and visuals feeling right together, so I’m mainly sharing this early to see what resonates with tactics fans and hear honest feedback.

**Early preview & in-engine clips:** [https://severedstrands.com/](https://severedstrands.com/)

*(There’s also a small interactive class/gear/forecast preview on the page, plus a mailing list if you want occasional updates.)*

You can also follow along on [X (@severedstrands)](https://x.com/severedstrands) or [Instagram (@severedstrandsgame)](https://www.instagram.com/severedstrandsgame?fqnt=MTVveXA0NmFsZDE2eA==).

Happy to answer any questions about the mechanics or the workflow—thanks for taking a look!
